verdict.rationale: First-party docs say OpenRouter reaches hundreds of models from 80+ providers through a single endpoint, normalizes the request/response schema so developers learn only one, standardizes tool calling, streams from any model, and works as a drop-in for the OpenAI SDK. A published OpenAPI spec backs this up, and independent users confirm they can switch models with the same key and request without dealing with each provider's own API. Missing for 10: the normalized interface does not expose every provider- or engine-specific option (e.g. full sampling parameters, per-request LoRA/steering), per community reports.
